chthird_stage.label:
Welcome! I, [FE4B71]Joy Han[-], will appear on the first stage!
Please take good care of Guitar Girl!

Today, I saw the compatibility of each blood type on social media, and it said that I''m very compatible with type [FE4B71]A[-] blood types.
Who is type A in our class?

The new homeroom teacher told us his birthday is in [FE4B71]November[-].
I''ll make sure to give him something in second semester!

When my friend at the convenience store sees us, she sometimes says that she misses being a [FE4B71]student[-].
I want to hurry and graduate, but will I also feel that way after graduating?

My friend from the class next door told me there''s a peculiar kid in her class.
I think her name was [FE4B71]Moa Lim[-].

I don''t want to remember what happened in [FE4B71]October[-].
... When will I be okay with it?

Before, I was looking at blood type compatibility and I found out about the class president''s blood type.
It said [FE4B71]B[-]. I didn''t expect it at all!
I don''t think I''m the only one surprised!

I heard their holding a school president election this time around.
An upperclassman named [FE4B71]Haily Joo[-] was elected last year. I heard she''s running again this time.
She''s very popular. I wonder if she''ll be elected this time around.

While looking around the musical instrument store with Guitar Girl, I saw a picture of a concert.
In the picture, you can see a band performing.
Below, it says "Perfect Day. [FE4B71]January[-] 23".

What if Guitar Girl came here in [FE4B71]March[-]
and I didn''t know that she was a transfer student?
Would we have been friends like we are now...?
Or would I have kept my distance from you?

Young [FE4B71]Moa Lim[-]''s dream of wanting to become a pianist.
My brother asked me what kind of pianist I wanted to be.
I...

My big brother Sean''s blood type is [FE4B71]B[-], just like me.
My classmates keep teasing me, saying that type B doesn''t have a good personality. But Sean is very kind.
They are liars.

On my way to eat lunch with Eugene, I saw many [FE4B71]students[-] in school uniforms.
Going to school on the weekends... What kind of school is that?

[FE4B71]November[-] is coming.
While talking about high school, everyone has been talking about their concerns.
Everyone is having mixed feelings.

A classmate who likes idols cried this morning.
She was criticized by her parents for still liking [FE4B71]singers[-].
... Would I feel that way if I was scolded for liking something like Chopin?

"Let''s go to the same Arts High School next year and stick together!"
It was a promise I made with Eugene in [FE4B71]January[-].
It''s now a promise I can''t keep nor want to keep.

I heard the transfer student next door who plays the guitar transferred here in [FE4B71]April[-].
I didn''t care at the time. I didn''t even know she was here.
But to transfer in April. That''s an odd time to transfer.

I was informed that big brother Sean, who left for Berlin, is returning.
It''s been 4 years. He''s now [FE4B71]24 years old[-].
When he''s here, I''ll make fun of him by saying he''s old.

There was a variety of performances.
Nanta, singing, dancing and even magic...
Among them, there was a freshman that came from a different country. I think her name was [FE4B71]Alex[-].

He said he saw many different people in Berlin.
From [FE4B71]students[-] to older people.
There were many things to be seen and learned. My brother said he worked hard to do better.
